name: kd-hybrid-workspace
description: An open-source hybrid Rust/WASM performance layer and compatibility host for Kinky Dungeon.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts && npm run build:bundle
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/kd-wasm --release --target web --out-dir ../../dist/wasm-web --out-name kd_hybrid_core && wasm-pack build crates/kd-wasm --release --target no-modules --out-dir ../../dist/wasm-nomod --out-name kd_hybrid_core
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:source-cache-key && npm run rust:test
scripts.package: npm run build && node packages/tools/dist/cli.js package --output artifacts/kd-hybrid.zip
